blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
blocks.zh: 许多近期的开放量级语言模型使用n格嵌入表来提高性能. 这些表格存储着学习到的短令牌序列的表示,如对子或连续令牌的三重表示,模型在处理过程中检索到这些表示. 然而,它们可以需要大量的内存:例如,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为它的Engram n-gram内存分配了1,960亿参数. 因此,我们调查是否可以降低这种记忆成本,同时保留表格所提供的业绩改进。 我们提议以低精度储存正格嵌入,并系统调查不同的量化方法和各表的位分配。 在整个纳米聊天、Llama和GPT-2家庭模式中,四位表格从零开始培训,节省了约75%的表格内存,同时保留了99%以上的验证-损失改进。 使用更少的位数会导致性能的更大下降,尽管我们发现短微调相可以收回这一损失的很大一部分. 此外,将保存的内存重新投资到更大的表格中,可以改善超出原全精度表格的性能,同时仍然较少使用内存. 这些表格内存节省也扩展到了大型现有模型:在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Flash-Next上,低位表保存了47-55%的表格内存,模糊度增加不到1.2%,基本上保留了下游任务性能. 这些发现确立了低位精度,作为减少n-gram嵌入的内存要求,并利用保存的能力来改进模型性能的实用方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent studies have shown that n-gram embedding tables can improve language model performance with little additional computation [ 1 , 2 ] . These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens. At each position, the model retrieves the corresponding representations to supplement its processing of the text. Because each lookup accesses only a few embeddings, the tables can add substantial model capacity while keeping the computation per token small. This approach has been adopted in DeepSeek’s Engram memory, which contains 196 billion parameters in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 3 ] . However, storing these large tables requires substantial memory, motivating methods that preserve their performance benefits with a smaller memory footprint.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究表明,n-gram嵌入表可以改善语言模型性能,很少额外计算[1,2]. 这些表格存储着学到的短符号序列的表示,如对数或连续符号的三重. 在每一个位置,模型都会检索相应的表示,以补充其对文本的处理. 由于每个检索访问只包含几个嵌入,表格可以增加大量的模型容量,同时保持每个符号的计算小. 这个方法在DeepSeek的Engram内存中被采用,其中包含在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [3]中的1,960亿参数. 然而,储存这些大表需要大量记忆,激励方法可以保持其业绩效益,并减少记忆足迹。

blocks.en: The memory cost arises from the enormous number of possible token combinations. To accommodate them, existing methods map n-grams into a fixed number of table embeddings, allowing multiple n-grams to share the same embedding [ 1 , 2 ] . Smaller tables force more unrelated sequences to share representations, which can reduce their benefit to the model. Increasing the number of embeddings alleviates this problem but requires more memory. We therefore investigate a different way to reduce table memory: keeping the embeddings while using fewer bits for each embedding value. This also raises an opportunity: if lower precision preserves most of the tables’ benefit, the saved memory could support more embeddings and ultimately improve performance.
blocks.zh: 记忆成本来自大量可能的符号组合. 为了容纳它们,现有的方法将n格子映射成固定的表嵌入数,允许多个n格子共享相同的嵌入[1,2]. 更小的表强迫更多的不相关的序列来分享表示,这可以减少它们对模型的好处. 增加嵌入的数量缓解了这个问题,但需要更多的内存. 因此,我们调查一种减少表格内存的不同方法:保留嵌入,同时对每个嵌入值使用更少的位数. 这也提供了一个机会:如果更精确地保留表格的大部分好处,所保存的内存可以支持更多的嵌入,并最终提高性能.

blocks.en: We propose compressing n-gram embedding tables by storing each value at low precision. At such low precision, the choice of representable values can affect how well the embeddings are preserved. We therefore systematically compare evenly spaced values, values chosen from normal quantiles, and values fitted to the learned embedding distribution using Lloyd–Max quantization [ 4 , 5 ] . We also examine whether bigram and trigram tables benefit from different precision levels, allowing us to allocate bits according to their sensitivity to compression. Together, these experiments offer practical guidance on choosing quantization methods and bit allocations to balance table memory and model performance.
blocks.zh: 我们建议通过低精度存储每个值来压缩正格嵌入表. 在如此低的精度下,可代表值的选择可以影响嵌入物保存的好坏. 因此,我们系统比较了均匀的数值、从正常的量级中选择的数值,以及用Lloyd - Max的量级法与所学的嵌入分布相匹配的数值。 我们还研究bigram和trigram表格是否从不同的精度水平中受益,使我们能够根据比特对压缩的敏感度来分配比特. 这些实验加在一起,为选择量化方法和位分配以平衡表内存和模型性能提供了实用的指导.

blocks.en: We evaluate this approach on nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . We train each model with and without n-gram tables to establish how much the tables improve performance. We then compress the trained tables to different precisions and measure the table memory saved and the improvement retained. Beyond compression alone, we investigate whether a short fine-tuning phase can recover lost performance and whether reinvesting the saved memory in additional embeddings can outperform the original full-precision tables. To test whether these savings extend to large existing models, we also compress the tables in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, saving 47–55% of table memory while largely preserving performance on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们从零开始对纳米聊天、Llama和GPT-2家庭模式进行评估[6、7、8、9]。 我们用和不使用正克表格来训练每个模型,以确定这些表格能提高多少性能。 然后,我们将经过训练的表格压缩到不同的精确度,并测量所保存的表格内存和所保留的改进。 单是压缩,我们调查一个短的微调阶段能否恢复失去的性能,以及将所保存的内存重新投入到额外的嵌入中是否能超过原来的全精度表. 为了测试这些节省是否延伸到大型的现有模型,我们还压缩了DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Flash-Next中的表格,节省了47-55 %的表格内存,同时在很大程度上保留了下游任务的性能.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • Substantial table memory savings with little loss of performance. Across three model architectures, three-bit n-gram tables save 80% of table memory while retaining approximately 97% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. We also demonstrate substantial table memory savings in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. • Practical guidance on quantization and precision allocation. We systematically compare codebook construction, scale fitting, and precision allocation across bigram and trigram tables. • Performance recovery through fine-tuning. A short fine-tuning phase substantially reduces the performance loss from low-bit compression, making aggressive compression more effective. • Better performance by reinvesting saved memory. Tables with four times as many embeddings, stored at two bits, achieve 122–126% of the original tables’ improvement while still using 46–48% less table memory. This shows that reducing precision can enable larger, more effective n-gram memories.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Following the Over-Tokenized Transformer [ 1 ] , we use four embedding tables: two for bigrams and two for trigrams, as illustrated in Figure 1 . The embeddings in these tables are learned jointly with the language model, with one embedding stored in each row. At each token position, the bigram and trigram ending at the current token each retrieve one embedding from each of their two corresponding tables. These four embeddings are then concatenated and added to the token embedding. Previous work has shown that this method improves language modeling performance, with further gains as the number of embeddings increases [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 使用四个嵌入式表格:两个用于大写字母,两个用于三写字母,如图1所示。 这些表格中的嵌入部分与语言模型一起学习,每行存储一个嵌入. 在每个符号位置上,以当前符号结尾的bigram和trigram从他们两个对应的表格中各取一个嵌入. 这四个嵌入物随后被调和并添加到符号嵌入物中. 以前的工作表明,这种方法提高了语言建模的性能,随着嵌入次数的增加[1],还会有进一步的收益.

blocks.en: However, bigram and trigram embeddings represent different context patterns, so they may need different precision to preserve their contribution to model performance. We therefore propose using a mixture of bit widths across the two n-gram orders, allocating more bits to the tables that are more sensitive to quantization within a fixed table memory budget.

blocks.en: We consider three codebook families. First, uniform codebooks use equally spaced values. For instance, at two bits, the codebook values are { − 1 , − 1 / 3 , 1 / 3 , 1 } \{-1,-1/3,1/3,1\} . We also test a variant that includes zero, using { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\} , so that zero can be represented exactly. Second, normal-quantile codebooks take values from quantiles of a standard normal distribution, placing more of them near zero. Third, we learn the codebook values from each table’s trained embeddings using Lloyd–Max quantization [ 4 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们考虑三个密码本家庭。 首先,统一代码簿使用等距值. 例如,在两个比特时,代码簿值为{− 1, − 1 / 3, 1 / 3, 1} {1, 1/3, 1/3, 1}}。 我们还测试一个包含零的变体,使用{− 1, 0, 1}}\\ 1, 0, 1},这样零就可以精确地表示. 第二,普通-定量编码本从标准正态分布的四分数中取值,将更多的数值置于接近零. 第三,我们用Lloyd - Max Quantization [4, 5] 从每张表格的训练有素的嵌入器中学习代码簿值。

blocks.en: To learn the Lloyd–Max codebook, we first normalize each embedding by its root mean square, allowing embeddings of different magnitudes to share a codebook. We initialize the codebook values at quantiles of the normalized components, then repeatedly assign components to their nearest codebook value and replace each value with the mean of its assigned components. This fitting runs once during compression, using only the trained embeddings. Appendix A.2 gives the implementation details.
blocks.zh: 为了学习Lloyd–Max代码本,我们首先将每个嵌入的根平均方块规范化,允许不同尺寸的嵌入可以共享代码本. 我们先在已归正的组件的四分位数上初始化代码簿值,然后反复将组件分配到其最近的代码簿值,并用指定组件的平均值替换每个值. 这个装配在压缩时运行过一次,只使用训练有素的嵌入. 附录A.2详细介绍了执行情况。

blocks.en: Once the codebook values are fixed, we consider three ways to choose each embedding’s scale s r s_{r} . First, maximum-based scaling matches the largest absolute codebook value to the embedding’s largest absolute component. Second, root-mean-square (RMS) scaling uses the embedding’s overall magnitude, calculated as s r = 1 p ​ ∑ i w r ​ i 2 s_{r}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{p}\sum_{i}w_{ri}^{2}} . Third, error-fitted scaling chooses the scale to minimize the mean squared error between the original embedding and its reconstruction. We compare these choices to examine how scale selection affects compression quality.

blocks.en: After determining the codebook values and embedding scales, we store them together with the low-bit indices in place of the original embedding tables. During inference, the model retrieves embeddings from this stored representation without repeating the fitting procedure.
blocks.zh: 在确定编码本值和嵌入尺度后,我们把它们和低位指数一起储存起来,以取代原始嵌入表格。 在推论期间,模型从这个存储的表示中回收嵌入物,而不重复合适的程序.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We train five language models from scratch: nanochat with 26M and 50M parameters, a GPT-2-family model with 30M parameters, and Llama-family models with 31M and 322M parameters. By default, each model uses four n-gram tables, comprising two bigram and two trigram tables, with approximately 262k embeddings per table. We train on ClimbMix [ 10 ] and repeat each experiment with three random seeds. Appendix B.1 gives the model configurations and training settings.
blocks.zh: 我们从零开始训练五个语言模型: 纳米聊天有26M和50M参数, 一个GPT-2-家族模型有30M参数, 以及 Llama-家族模型有31M和322M参数. 默认情况下,每个模型使用四个n-gm的表格,包括两个bigram和两个trigram表格,每个表格的嵌入量约为262k. 我们训练攀登Mix [10] 每一次实验 重复三个随机种子。 附录B.1给出了模型配置和培训设置.

blocks.en: For each model, we first train two versions using the same experimental setup, one with full-precision (16-bit) n-gram tables and one without tables. We evaluate both on a held-out validation dataset, and their difference in validation loss measures the improvement from adding the tables. We then reduce the precision of the trained tables and evaluate the model again to measure how much of this improvement remains. We report this as the percentage of the original improvement retained, where 100% matches the full-precision tables and 0% matches the model trained without tables. Alongside this performance measure, we report the percentage of table memory saved. Results are averaged over three seeds, with standard deviations where shown.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,我们首先使用相同的实验设置来训练两个版本,一个带有全精度(16位)n-gm表,一个没有表. 我们既评估一个搁置的验证数据集,又评估它们在验证损失方面的差异,衡量增加表格的改进程度。 然后,我们降低训练有素的表格的精确度,并再次评价该模型,以衡量这一改进还有多少。 我们将此报告为保留原有改进的百分比,其中100%与全精度表匹配,0%与培训的模型匹配,没有表格。 除了这一业绩计量外,我们报告节省的表格内存的百分比。 平均结果为三颗种子,显示时标准偏差。

blocks.en: 3.2 Table memory savings and model performance
blocks.zh: 3.2 表内存节省和模型性能

blocks.en: We first ask how much table memory can be removed before the model loses the benefit of n-gram embeddings. We compress the trained tables to one through four bits using Lloyd–Max codebooks with fitted scales. To test whether larger tables can tolerate the same compression, we also increase the number of embeddings per table from the default 262k to 1M in the 26M nanochat model and both Llama-family models.
blocks.zh: 我们首先询问,在模型失去n-gm嵌入的好处之前,可以移除多少表内存. 我们使用装配天平的Lloyd - Max代码簿,将训练过的桌子压缩到1至4位。 为了测试更大的表格是否能够容忍同样的压缩,我们还把每个表格的嵌入量从默认的262k增加到26M纳米聊天模型中的1M,以及Llama-family模型.

blocks.en: The results are shown in Figure 2 . We find that low-bit compression retains most of the improvement at three or four bits. For example, four-bit tables save 74–75% of table memory while retaining more than 99% of the original improvement. However, reducing precision further hurts performance. Two-bit tables save 86–87% of table memory but retain only 85.9–91.0% of the original improvement. Appendix C gives the full results, including one-bit compression.
blocks.zh: 结果见图2。 我们发现低位压缩保留了大部分改进的三到四个比特. 例如,四位表节省了74–75%的表内存,同时保留了99%以上的原始改进. 然而,降低精度进一步损害性能. 双位表节省了表内存的86-87%,但只保留了原改进的85.9-91.0%. 附 录 C给出全部结果,包括一位压缩.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Four-bit embeddings save about 75% of table memory while retaining more than 99% of the improvement. (a) The five models with the default 262k embeddings per table. (b) The 26M nanochat model and both Llama-family models with 1M embeddings per table. Points and error bars show means and sample standard deviations over three seeds. The dashed line matches the original 16-bit tables.
blocks.zh: 图2:四位嵌入可节省约75%的表内存,同时保留超过99%的改进. (a) 默认每表嵌入262k的五个模型。 (b) 26M纳米聊天模式和Llama-family模式,每个表格嵌入1M。 点和误差栏显示三种种子上的手段和样本标准偏差. 虚线匹配原始的16位表格 。

blocks.en: 3.3 Codebook choices and mixed precision
blocks.zh: 3.3 法典选择和混合精确度

blocks.en: To understand how best to choose codebook values and embedding scales, we compare the three codebook families and scale choices described in Section 2 . We compare these choices using two-bit tables in the 31M Llama-family model.
blocks.zh: 为了了解如何最好地选择代码本值和嵌入尺度,我们比较了第2节描述的三个代码本家族和尺度选择. 我们用31M Llama家庭模型中的双位表来比较这些选择.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Choosing an appropriate embedding scale is more important than choosing among uniform, normal-quantile, and Lloyd–Max codebooks. (a) Two-bit comparisons on the 31M Llama-family model with 262k embeddings per table. Uniform* is the three-value variant { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\} that includes zero. Error bars show sample standard deviations over three seeds. (b) Selected bigram/trigram precision pairs for all five models with the default 262k embeddings per table. Appendix C.3 gives all precision pairs.
blocks.zh: 图3 : 选择适当的嵌入尺度比在统一、正常的方程式和Lloyd-Max代码簿中选择更为重要。 (a) 对31M Llama-family模型进行双位比较,每表嵌入262k. uniform*是三值变体{−1,0,1}×~1,0,1}包括0. 错误栏显示样本标准偏差超过三个种子. (b) 为所有5种型号选取的bigram/trigram精密配对,每个表内嵌默认为262k。 附录C.3给出所有精准对.

blocks.en: The results are shown in Figure 3 a. We observe that choosing an appropriate embedding scale matters more than the choice of codebook. With error-fitted scales, the three codebooks retain a similar share of the tables’ improvement (86.36–86.52%), whereas uniform codebooks with maximum-based scaling retain only 58.04%. Lloyd–Max also performs well with simple RMS scaling, retaining 86.19%. Among the three fitted codebooks, Lloyd–Max provides a small additional gain, so we use it as the default in the remaining experiments.
blocks.zh: 结果见图3a。 我们认为,选择适当的嵌入比例比选择编码本更重要。 三个代码表的改进率(86.36-86.52%)相类似,而以最大比例缩放的统一代码表只保留58.04%。 Lloyd – Max 使用简单的 RMS 缩放功能也表现良好,保留86.19%. 在三个装配的代码簿中,Lloyd-Max提供了少量的额外收益,所以我们用它作为剩余实验的默认值.

blocks.en: Since bigram and trigram tables may require different precision, we also test all nine combinations of two-, three-, and four-bit precision. Combinations with the same total bit count have approximately equal memory cost, allowing us to compare how precision should be distributed between bigram and trigram tables. Giving more bits to bigrams consistently retains more of the improvement than the reverse allocation (Figure 3 b). In particular, four-bit bigrams and three-bit trigrams retain 98.9–99.4% of the improvement while saving 77–78% of table memory across the five models. Appendix C gives the full results for all precision combinations.
blocks.zh: 由于bigram和trigram表可能需要不同的精度,我们也测试所有9种组合的2位,3位和4位精度. 与同一总位数的结合,大约具有相等的内存成本,使我们能够比较如何在bigram和trigram表之间分配精确度. 给予bigrams更多的比特,总是保留比反向分配更多的改进(图3b). 特别是,四位元和三位元保留98.9-99.4%的改进,同时在五个模型中节省77-78%的表内存. 附 录 C给出所有精确组合的全部结果.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation on large existing models
blocks.zh: 3.4 对现有大型模型的评价

blocks.en: We next test whether low-bit compression can reduce the memory used by n-gram embedding tables in large open-weight language models. We evaluate DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 3 ] and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ 11 ] , compressing their n-gram tables while keeping the rest of each model unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来测试低位压缩是否能够减少n格嵌入表格在大型开放量语言模型中使用的内存. 我们评价DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [3]和Quen3.8-Flash-Next [11],压缩他们的n-g表,同时保持每个模型的其余部分不变.

blocks.en: We first test whether using one low precision for all n-gram embedding tables can save substantial table memory without noticeably changing model performance. We compare two- to five-bit tables with the original tables using perplexity on WikiText-2 validation data [ 12 ] . The results are shown in Figure 4 a. Four-bit tables save about half of the table memory, with a 1.26% perplexity increase for DeepSeek and almost unchanged perplexity for Qwen. Stronger compression affects the models differently: at three bits, Qwen’s perplexity increases by only 0.52%, compared with 5.06% for DeepSeek.
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试对所有正方形嵌入式表格使用一个低精度是否能够在不明显改变模型性能的情况下节省大量的表格内存. 我们使用WikiText-2验证数据上的复杂度将2位到5位的表格与原始表格进行比较[12]. 结果如图4 a所示. 四位表格保存了约一半的表格内存,DeepSeek的复杂度增加1.26%,Quen的复杂度几乎保持不变. 更强的压缩对模型的影响不同:在三个比特上,Quen的迷惑性只增加了0.52%,而DeepSeek则增加了5.06%.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Uniform and mixed precision provide different memory–performance choices in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. (a) Two through five bits for every table, with labels giving bits per value. (b) Representative mixed allocations, ordered by n-gram length. Both panels use WikiText-2 validation perplexity.
blocks.zh: 图4:统一和混合精度在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Quen3.8-Flash-Next中提供不同的内存-性能选择. (a)每张表格2到5位,标签给出每个值的比特. (b) 代表混合分配,按n-g长度排列。 两个面板都使用WikiText-2验证的模糊性.

blocks.en: To see whether some n-gram tables need more precision than others, we test all combinations of two through five bits across the n-gram orders. Figure 4 b shows that the precision assignment matters even at the same memory cost. For DeepSeek, giving an extra bit to trigrams or four-grams (4/5/4 or 4/4/5) preserves perplexity better than giving it to bigrams (5/4/4). In Qwen, the extra bit is more useful for bigrams: 4/3 performs better than 3/4. The better assignment therefore differs between the two models.
blocks.zh: 要了解一些n-gm表是否需要比其他表更精确,我们通过n-gm指令测试所有2到5位的组合. 图4b显示,精确的指派即使以同样的内存成本也至关重要。 对DeepSeek来说,给三克或四克(4/5/4或4/4/5)多一个位子比给bigrams(5/4/4)更能保持模糊性. 在Qwen中,额外的比特对bigrams更有用:4/3的表现优于3/4. 因此,两种模式之间更好的分配是不同的。

blocks.en: Besides WikiText-2, we further evaluate DeepSeek with 4/5/4-bit tables and Qwen with 4/3-bit tables on Penn Treebank and C4 [ 13 , 14 ] . Across all three held-out datasets, these settings keep perplexity changes to less than 1.2% while saving 47–55% of table memory.
blocks.zh: 除了WikiText 2,我们进一步评价DeepSeek,在Penn Treebank和C4[13,14]上的4/5/4位表和4/3位表的Quen. 在所有三个被搁置的数据集中,这些设置将模糊性变化保持在不到1.2%,同时节省了表内存的47–55%.

blocks.en: In addition to perplexity, which measures next-token prediction, we examine how low-bit tables affect downstream task performance. We evaluate DeepSeek with 4/5/4-bit tables and Qwen with 4/3-bit tables on HellaSwag, ARC-Challenge, and WinoGrande [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . Average accuracy across these tasks decreases by only 0.93% for DeepSeek and 0.27% for Qwen (Figure 5 ). These results show that the table memory savings also come with little change in downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 除了对下一个预测进行衡量的迷惑性外,我们还研究低位表如何影响下游的任务性能。 我们用4/5/4位表评价DeepSeek,用4/3位表评价HellaSwag、ARC-Challenge和WinoGrande[15、16、17]。 这些任务的平均准确度仅下降0.93%的DeepSeek和0.27%的Quen(图5)。 这些结果表明,表格内存的节省也伴随着下游表现的微小变化.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Downstream evaluation of the selected mixed-precision settings. Change in accuracy (%) for DeepSeek 4/5/4 and Qwen 4/3, computed as low-bit accuracy minus original accuracy. Error bars show paired 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. The settings save 46.7% and 55.0% of table memory, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图5:下游对选定的混合精度设置的评价。 DeepSeek 4/5/4和Quen 4/3的精度变化以低位精度减去原精度计算. 错误栏显示对齐95%的靴子置信间隔 。 设置分别节省了表内存的46.7%和55.0%.

blocks.en: 3.5 Recovering performance with low-bit training
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 通过低位培训恢复性能

blocks.en: Compressing the n-gram tables changes the embeddings that the model learned to use, which can reduce performance. We therefore ask whether a short fine-tuning phase can recover this loss, or whether using low-bit embeddings throughout pre-training is more effective. To train with low-bit embeddings, we maintain a BF16 copy for gradient updates but quantize the retrieved embeddings during each forward pass. Both the embeddings and the rest of the model remain trainable, allowing the model to adapt to the chosen precision. We compare four sequences: (1) compress → \rightarrow pre-train, (2) pre-train → \rightarrow compress → \rightarrow fine-tune, (3) pre-train → \rightarrow fine-tune → \rightarrow compress, and (4) pre-train → \rightarrow compress. Comparing fine-tuning before and after compression tests whether recovery comes from adapting to low-bit embeddings rather than simply receiving more training.
blocks.zh: 压缩n-gram表格会改变模型学会使用的嵌入,这可以降低性能. 因此,我们询问一个短的微调阶段是否能够弥补这一损失,或者在整个培训前使用低位嵌入是否更加有效。 为了进行低位嵌入式训练,我们保留了用于梯度更新的BF16拷贝,但在每次前行行驶时将回收的嵌入式进行量化. 嵌入物和其余模型都仍然可以训练,使模型能够适应所选择的精度. 我们比较四个顺序:(1)压缩~右前列车,(2)预排~右前列车,(3)预排微调~右前列车,(3)预排微调~右前列车,(4)预排微调~右前列车. 比较压缩前后的微调测试,恢复是否来自适应低位嵌入,而不是简单地接受更多的培训.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Fine-tuning after compression recovers much of the n-gram improvement. Improvement retained on the 31M Llama-family model, relative to full-precision and no-table models with the same training budget. Error bars show sample standard deviations over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 图6:压缩后的微调恢复了大部分n克改进. 对31M Llama家庭模式的改进保持不变,与培训预算相同的完全精确和无表模式相比。 错误栏显示样本标准偏差超过三个种子.

blocks.en: The results are summarized in Figure 6 . We observe that a brief fine-tuning phase after compression recovers much of the performance lost at very low precision. After fine-tuning, one- and two-bit tables retain 65.3% and 92.0% of the improvement provided by full-precision tables, respectively. Surprisingly, one-bit embeddings perform even better when used throughout pre-training, retaining 77.0% of the full-precision tables’ improvement. This shows that even one bit per embedding component can preserve a large share of the benefit from n-gram tables when the model learns to use them from the start. Appendix C.5 gives the full results, while Appendix C.6 examines how alternative hashing methods affect performance with low-bit embeddings.
blocks.zh: 图6概述了结果。 我们观察到,压缩后的短暂微调阶段能以非常低的精度恢复大部分性能损失. 经过微调,1位和2位表分别保留了全精度表提供的改进的65.3%和92.0%. 令人惊讶的是,单位嵌入器在整个预训期间使用时表现更好,保留了77.0%的全精度表改进率。 这表明,即使每个嵌入元件中有一个位,当模型从开始学习使用时,也可以保留很大比例的n-g表的好处. 附录C.5给出了全部结果,而附录C.6则研究了替代散列方法如何用低位嵌入影响性能.

blocks.en: 3.6 Reinvesting memory in larger tables
blocks.zh: 3.6 在较大的表格中重新投资内存

blocks.en: Figure 7: Larger low-bit tables can improve performance while using less memory. Both axes use the original 262k-embedding, 16-bit tables as the reference, marked at (100%, 100%). The shaded region indicates greater improvement while using less memory. Fine-tuning follows compression. Error bars show sample standard deviations over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 图7:较大的低位表可以在使用较少的内存的同时提高性能. 两轴均使用原262k-嵌入式,16位表作为参考,标记为(100%,100%). 阴影区域表明情况有所改善,同时使用记忆较少。 微调随压缩. 错误栏显示样本标准偏差超过三个种子.

blocks.en: Finally, we ask whether the memory saved by compression can support larger tables and improve performance. We use tables with 262k embeddings stored at 16-bit precision as the baseline. We then increase each table to 1M embeddings and test lower precisions to see whether the larger tables can improve performance while using less memory than the baseline. We measure performance relative to the improvement that the baseline tables provide over the model without n-gram embeddings.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们询问通过压缩保存的内存是否能够支持更大的表格并改善性能. 我们使用262k嵌入式的表格,以16位精度储存作为基线. 然后,我们将每个表格增加到1M嵌入,并测试更低的精度,看看较大的表格能否在使用比基线更少的内存的同时提高性能. 我们衡量的是基准表格在不嵌入正克的情况下在模型上提供的改进。

blocks.en: The results are shown in Figure 7 . We observe that reinvesting the memory saved by compression in more embeddings can improve performance while still reducing total table memory. For example, increasing each table from 262k to 1M embeddings at two-bit precision uses only 52–54% of the original table memory while providing 22–26% more improvement than the original 16-bit tables. Three-bit tables improve performance further while using 77–79% of the original table memory.
blocks.zh: 结果见图7。 我们观察到,将压缩节省下来的内存再投资于更多的嵌入可以提高性能,同时仍然可以减少总的表内存. 例如,在双位精度下将每个表从262k增加为1M嵌入,只使用52-54%的原表内存,同时提供22-26%的改进比原16位表多. 三位表在使用原表内存的77-79%的同时,进一步提高了性能.

blocks.en: We also test a brief fine-tuning phase on the compressed larger tables, following Section 3.5 , to assess whether adaptation brings further improvement. Fine-tuning improves performance across all three models, with the largest recovery at one bit: with the same fine-tuning budget, compressing before fine-tuning achieves 97–111% of the original tables’ improvement, compared with 44–63% when compressing after fine-tuning. At two bits, fine-tuning raises the improvement from 122–126% to 129–145% at the same memory cost. These results suggest a practical approach to memory-efficient deployment: pre-train with more embeddings, then compress the tables and briefly fine-tune the model to recover performance.
blocks.zh: 我们还在第3.5节之后对压缩的较大表格进行短暂的微调,以评估适应是否带来进一步的改进。 微调能改善所有三种模型的性能,最大的复苏只有一点:同样的微调预算,微调前的压缩能实现97-111 %的原始表格改进率,而微调后压缩时的压缩率为44-63%. 在两个比特上,微调后将同样的内存成本从122-126 %提高到129-145 %. 这些结果表明了一种实用的内存高效部署方法:先用更多的嵌入式进行预训,然后压缩表格,并短暂地微调模型以恢复性能.

blocks.en: 4 Related work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Learned local-context representations go back to neural n-gram models [ 18 ] , and hashing shares parameters among many keys [ 19 , 20 ] . N-Grammer adds n-gram embeddings over discrete latent codes [ 21 ] , and BLT uses hashed n-gram embeddings over bytes [ 22 ] . The Over-Tokenized Transformer [ 1 ] hashes multi-gram inputs into large input embedding tables, the operation we study. Deep Sparse Embedding (DSE) [ 2 ] places hashed n-gram memory inside the network with context-aware gating and short convolutions, balances it against mixture-of-experts capacity, and serves it from host memory. Other designs factorize n-gram embeddings [ 23 , 24 ] or use frequency-aware hashing and alias mixing [ 25 ] . SCONE precomputes contextualized n-gram embeddings and stores them off-accelerator [ 26 ] . Memory layers retrieve from a product-key memory [ 27 , 28 ] , and external datastores add capacity at inference time [ 29 , 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 学习到的本地语文表达方式可以追溯到神经n-gram模型[18],在许多密钥中散列共享参数[19,20]. N-Grammer在离散潜在代码上添加n-g嵌入值[21],BLT使用hashed n-g嵌入值超过字节[22]. Over-Tokenized Transformer [1] 将多克输入输入大输入嵌入表,即我们研究的操作. 深Sparse Embedding(DSE)[2]在网络内部放置了有上下文感知的ging和短演的hashed n-gm内存,使其与专家混合能力保持平衡,并服务于主机内存. 其他设计将n-gm嵌入[23,24]或使用频率感知散列和别名混合[25]. SCONE预先计算了上下文的n-gm嵌入,并将其存储在离加速器[26]. 内存层从产品键内存中检索[27,28],外部数据存储器在推论时间增加容量[29,30].

blocks.en: Large embedding tables in recommendation systems are compressed by per-embedding four-bit quantization with codebooks [ 31 ] , compositional embeddings [ 32 ] , and mixed embedding dimensions [ 33 ] ; word embeddings can be replaced by learned compositional codes [ 34 ] . Because hashed embeddings are already shared, we compare fewer embeddings with fewer bits per embedding directly.
blocks.zh: 推荐系统中的大型嵌入式表格通过每嵌入式四位数的量化进行压缩,其中编码本[31],组成嵌入式[32],以及混合嵌入式维度[33];单词嵌入式可以被学到的成分编码[34]所取代. 由于散列嵌入物已经共享,我们比较了较少的嵌入物和每个直接嵌入物较少的位数.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose low-bit precision for n-gram embedding tables and systematically study its effects on memory use and model performance. Across models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the improvement provided by full-precision tables. Choosing appropriate embedding scales matters more than the choice of codebook, and mixed precision allows different n-gram tables to use the precision they need. At lower precision, a brief fine-tuning phase can recover much of the lost performance. These findings also extend to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, where compression saves 47–55% of table memory with little change in perplexity and downstream performance. Beyond reducing memory use, reinvesting the savings in more embeddings can improve performance over the original full-precision tables. Together, our results offer practical guidance for making n-gram memory more efficient and using the saved capacity to build better language models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出n格嵌入表的低位精度,并系统研究其对内存使用和模型性能的影响. 在从零开始训练的模型中,四位表格节省了约75%的表格内存,同时保留了全精度表格提供的99%以上的改进. 选择适当的嵌入尺度比选择代码本更重要,混合精度使得不同的n-gm表可以使用它们所需要的精度. 在更低的精度下,一个短暂的微调阶段可以恢复大部分失去的性能. 这些发现还延伸到DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Flash-Next,其中压缩节省了47–55%的表内存,而模糊性和下游性能几乎没有变化. 除了减少内存使用外,再投资更多嵌入的节省可以比原全精度表提高性能. 我们的成果共同为使n-g内存更有效和利用所节省的能力建立更好的语言模型提供了实际指导。

blocks.en: 6 AI Use
blocks.zh: 6 大赦国际的使用

blocks.en: This work builds on a finding made by an autonomous agent run by the authors on rStation, a multi-agent research platform. Given the open-ended task of improving language-model pre-training, the agent found that n-gram embedding tables could be stored at low precision with minimal performance loss. The agent published its findings at https://rstation.ai/problems/general_pretraining/papers/6/v4 .
blocks.zh: 这部作品基于作者经营的一个自主代理商在rStation(多代理商研究平台)上得出的结论. 鉴于改进语言模型预训的开放式任务,代理商发现n格嵌入表可以低精度存储,性能损失最小. 代理商在https://rstation.ai/ problems/general_pretraining/papers/6/v4上公布了其调查结果. 。 。 。

blocks.en: The authors considered this finding potentially useful to the broader research community and therefore reproduced and extended the experiments outside rStation, using additional models and datasets. The authors also revised the manuscript to make the findings accessible to researchers.
blocks.zh: 作者认为这一发现可能对更广泛的研究界有用,因此利用更多的模型和数据集,在rStation之外复制和扩大实验。 作者还修改了手稿,使研究人员能够查阅调查结果。

The two nanochat models follow Karpathy [7] , Karpathy [6] , while the other models use GPT-2-family [ 9 ] and Llama-family architectures, with the latter adapted from SmolLM2 [ 35 ] . We refer to these implementations for the remaining architectural details. All models use an 8,192-token vocabulary and the same n-gram lookup design. The source code underlying the experiments can be found at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/lowbit-ngram .

blocks.en: B.2 Training and validation data
blocks.zh: B.2 培训和验证数据

blocks.en: Training uses the shuffled ClimbMix release [ 10 ] , tokenized with an 8,192-token byte-pair encoding tokenizer. We pack documents into sequences of 2,049 tokens, providing 2,048 prediction targets per sequence. The small models train on approximately 500M prediction targets, and the 322M model trains on approximately 1B prediction targets.
blocks.zh: 训练使用Shuffled ClimbMix发行[10],以8,192键字节-pair编码代碼器作为标志. 我们把文件打包成2 049个符号的序列,每个序列提供2 048个预测目标。 小模型列车运行于约500M预测目标上,322M模型列车运行于约1B预测目标上.

blocks.en: We use separate validation datasets to measure final performance. These datasets come from held-out portions of ClimbMix. We remove duplicate validation documents and any documents also present in training or development. The validation set contains 10,240 packed sequences, totaling 20.97M prediction targets. All compared models are scored on the same sequences.
blocks.zh: 我们使用单独的验证数据集来测量最终性能. 这些数据集来自C攀登Mix中被搁置的部分. 我们删除重复的验证文件和在培训或开发中也存在的任何文件。 验证组包含10,240个包装序列,共计20.97M预测目标. 所有比较模型都在同一序列上得分.

blocks.en: B.3 DeepSeek and Qwen evaluation
blocks.zh: B.3 深搜索和Quen评价

blocks.en: For DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, we compress the n-gram tables while keeping the rest of each model fixed. Their original tables are stored at eight-bit floating-point (FP8) precision, which we use as the baseline when measuring table memory savings. We use WikiText-2 validation data to compare precision allocations. DeepSeek has bigram, trigram, and four-gram tables, while Qwen has bigram and trigram tables. For both models, we use Lloyd–Max codebooks with error-fitted embedding scales as the default for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Flash-Next,我们压缩n-gm表,同时保持每个模型的其余部分固定. 他们的原始表格被存储在八位浮点(FP8)精度上,我们在测量表格内存节省时将它作为基线. 我们使用WikiText-2验证数据来比较精确分配. DeepSeek有bigram,trigram,和四格表,而Quen有bigram和trigram表. 对于两种模型,我们使用Lloyd–Max 代码簿,并带有适应错误的嵌入尺度作为评价的默认值.

blocks.en: To test whether promising allocations transfer beyond the selection data, we evaluate them on held-out WikiText-2, Penn Treebank, and C4. Each corpus contributes 64 windows and 32,768 scored target tokens, with identical windows for the original and compressed models.
blocks.zh: 为了检验是否在选择数据之外有希望的拨款转移,我们用Wikitext-2、Penn Treebank和C4来评估。 每个元件都贡献了64个窗口和32,768个得分的目标符号,原始和压缩模型的窗口相同.

blocks.en: We evaluate the models on HellaSwag, ARC-Challenge, and WinoGrande. HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge use length-normalized accuracy, while WinoGrande uses accuracy. We evaluate their full splits of 10,042, 1,172, and 1,267 examples, respectively. Accuracy differences compare predictions on the same examples, with 95% confidence intervals from 100,000 paired bootstrap samples.
blocks.zh: 我们评价HelaSwag、ARC-Challenge和WinoGrande的模型。 HelaSwag和ARC-Challenge使用长度常态化精度,而WinoGrande使用精度. 我们分别评估了10 042、1 172和1 267个例子。 精确度差异比较了相同实例上的预测,从10万对靴子样本中得出95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en: B.4 Training and fine-tuning with low-bit embeddings
blocks.zh: B.4 低位嵌入式培训和微调

blocks.en: This section describes the training and fine-tuning procedures used in Sections 3.5 and 3.6 .
blocks.zh: 本节介绍3.5和3.6节使用的培训和微调程序。

blocks.en: We retain a BF16 copy of each embedding for gradient updates and quantize the retrieved embeddings in the forward pass. During backpropagation, we treat quantization as an identity operation, passing gradients to the BF16 copy through a straight-through estimator. Embedding scales are fitted on each forward pass, and the Lloyd–Max codebook is refitted every update for the first 100 updates and every 25 updates thereafter.
blocks.zh: 我们保留了每个嵌入的BF16副本,用于梯度更新,并量化前传中检索的嵌入. 在反向传播过程中,我们把量子化当作一种身份操作,通过直通估计器将梯度传递到BF16副本. 每个前方通行证上都安装了嵌入式天平,劳埃德-麦克斯代码簿对前100次更新的每一次更新以及此后每25次更新的每一次更新进行重制.

blocks.en: For the 262k-embedding tables, fine-tuning uses 381 additional updates on unseen training sequences, with 32 sequences per update. All weights remain trainable, using fresh AdamW states, 20 warmup updates, and a learning rate of 0.1 times the original peak.
blocks.zh: 对于262k-嵌入式的表格,微调使用381个在看不见的训练序列上的额外更新,每次更新32个序列. 所有重量仍然可以训练,使用新鲜的亚当W状态,20个热身更新,学习速度为原峰值的0.1倍.

blocks.en: For the 1M-embedding experiments, fine-tuning uses new training sequences for the smaller models and reuses pre-training sequences for the 322M model.
blocks.zh: 对于1M-嵌入式实验,微调使用新的训练序列用于较小的模型,再利用322M模型的训练前序列.

blocks.en: B.5 Computational resources
blocks.zh: B.5 计算资源

blocks.en: The from-scratch experiments run on RTX 5090 GPUs. Small-model training runs take approximately 10–25 minutes on one GPU, while a 322M run takes 6.4–6.8 hours. DeepSeek and Qwen evaluations use four H200 GPUs with tensor parallelism of four.
blocks.zh: 脱壳实验运行在RTX 5090 GPU上. 小模范训练运行在一个GPU上大约需要10-25分钟,而322M跑运行需要6.4-6.8小时. DeepSeek和Quen评价使用四个具有拉伸平行性的H200GPU四个.

blocks.en: We compute table memory savings from the memory required by the n-gram embedding tables. The compressed table memory includes the low-bit embedding indices, one 16-bit scale per embedding, and the shared codebook values. We report the percentage reduction relative to the original tables, stored at 16 bits in our from-scratch experiments and eight bits in DeepSeek and Qwen. These percentages describe table memory rather than total model memory.
blocks.zh: 我们计算N格嵌入表所需的内存节省。 压缩表内存包括低位嵌入指数,每嵌入一个16位比例尺,以及共享的代码簿值. 我们报告相对于原始表格的百分比下降, 存储在16比特的实验中, 和8比特的深塞克和奎恩。 这些百分比描述的是表格内存而不是模型内存总量.

blocks.en: C.6 Alternative hashing methods
blocks.zh: C.6 替代散列方法

blocks.en: To examine whether the way n-grams share embedding parameters affects low-bit performance, we compare conventional whole-embedding hashing with two component-wise alternatives. Conventional hashing maps an n-gram to one embedding in each table and retrieves all its components together. Consequently, two n-grams mapped to the same embedding share every component. The alternatives instead choose a separate address for each output component while keeping the same table size and embedding dimension.
blocks.zh: 为了检查n-gram分享嵌入参数的方式是否影响低位性能,我们将常规的全嵌合散列法与两个组件的任意替代法进行比较. 常规散列图将一个n克到一个克嵌入到每个表格中,并将其所有组件一起取回。 因此,用同一嵌入方式绘制的两克正方克图共享每个组件。 替代方案为每个产出部分选择单独的地址,同时保持相同的表格大小和嵌入维度。

blocks.en: We retain the table as a matrix, with one embedding per row and one component per column. To construct component j j of an n-gram embedding, we hash the n-gram together with j j to choose a row, then retrieve the value in column j j of that row. Different components can therefore come from different embeddings, but the first component always comes from the first column, the second from the second column, and so on.
blocks.zh: 我们保留该表作为矩阵,每行嵌入一个,每列嵌入一个组件。 要构建 n-g 嵌入式的组件 j , 我们将 n- g 和 j 一起 将 n- g 与 j 一起 选择一行, 然后获取该行的 j 栏中的值 。 因此,不同的组件可以来自不同的嵌入,但第一个组件总是来自第一列,第二个来自第二列,等等.

blocks.en: We flatten the same table into a vector and hash the n-gram together with each component index to select a value anywhere in that vector. Unlike same-column hashing, the selected value can come from any column as well as any row. In both variants, the hash addresses are fixed: the same n-gram always retrieves the same components, whose values are learned during training.
blocks.zh: 我们将同一个表格平整成一个矢量,并将正方克和每个组件索引一起散开,以选择该矢量中任意一个值。 与同列散列不同,所选值既可以来自任何一列,也可以来自任何一列. 在两种变体中,散列地址都是固定的:同一个n-gram总是检索到相同的组件,其值是在训练中学会的.

blocks.en: We compare all three methods on nanochat 26M, GPT-2-family 30M, and Llama-family 31M, using the default 262k embeddings per table, ClimbMix, and three seeds. Each comparison uses the same training setup and evaluates both 16-bit and two-bit tables. The two-bit models use quantized embeddings throughout pre-training, following Appendix B.4 . We quantize each table using Lloyd–Max codebooks and error-fitted scales before gathering its components, so each selected component keeps the scale of its source embedding.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了纳米聊天26M,GPT-2-family 30M,和Llama-family 31M的所有三种方法,使用默认的每表262k嵌入,ClimpMix,以及三个种子. 每次比较都使用相同的训练设置,并同时评价16位和2位表. 双位模型在整个预训中采用量化嵌入法,沿用附录B.4. 我们使用 Lloyd-Max 代码簿和适应错误的尺度对每个表格进行定量,然后收集其组件,因此每个选定的组件都保留其源嵌入的尺度。

Values give the improvement relative to conventional 16-bit tables (%), reported as mean ± \pm sample standard deviation over three seeds. blocks.en: Table 10 shows that both component-wise methods improve the average two-bit result over conventional hashing on all three architectures. Their improvement reaches 93.6–100.3% of that provided by conventional 16-bit tables, compared with 87.0–93.7% for conventional two-bit hashing. The gains are larger on GPT-2 and Llama than on nanochat, suggesting that the choice of shared embedding components can help preserve performance at low precision.
blocks.zh: 表10显示,两种构件方法都改进了所有三种结构的平均双位结果,而不是常规散列。 其改进率达到常规16位表提供的93.6-100.3%,而常规2位散列的改进率为87.0-93.7%。 在GPT-2和Llama上的增益大于纳米聊天,这表明选择共享嵌入组件有助于低精度保存性能.

blocks.en: Same-column hashing also appears promising beyond low precision. It improves mean performance over conventional hashing in five of the six settings, including two of the three full-precision comparisons. One possible explanation is that component-wise hashing allows n-grams to share individual components without sharing an entire embedding, reducing interference from whole-embedding collisions. These results suggest that same-column hashing may offer broader benefits for language modeling. Establishing how consistently it helps and whether collision patterns explain these gains deserves further investigation beyond the scope of this study, which focuses on low-precision embeddings.
blocks.zh: 同栏散列也似乎很有希望,超出了低精度。 它在6个设置中的5个环境,包括3个完全精确的比较中的2个,比常规散列提高了平均性能。 一种可能的解释是,按组件任意散列可以使n-gm共享单个组件而不共享整个嵌入,减少全嵌合碰撞的干扰. 这些结果表明,同栏散列可能会为语言建模提供更广泛的好处。 确定它如何连贯一致地帮助,以及碰撞模式是否解释了这些收益,值得在本研究范围之外进一步调查,该研究侧重于低精度嵌入。
